programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u006/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        marker = next((v for v in row if v != row[0]), None)\n        if marker is None:\n            continue\n        cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]\n        for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):\n            for c in range(a + 1, b):\n                if row[c] == row[0]:\n                    out[r][c] = 2\n    return out\n'''
